biotools.summary: scarecrow is a Python tool that addresses data loss in single-cell combinatorial barcoding experiments by flexibly identifying barcode sequences in reads, accounting for positional errors ('jitter'). It maximizes read retention and improves downstream analysis through error correction and standardized output.
biotools.name: scarecrow
